title: AlphaEarth Embeddings and Model-Based Inference for Remote Forest Inventory
description: Python/Jupyter workflow accompanying the manuscript "Bridging Forest Inventory Gaps in Remote and Inaccessible Temperate Mountain Forests Using AlphaEarth Embeddings and Model-Based Inference". The repository contains code for AlphaEarth embedding extraction, environmental-space exploration, Random Forest modeling, inference for unmeasured forest locations, wall-to-wall prediction, and bootstrap-based uncertainty assessment. Restricted National Forest Inventory data are not distributed.
